list.name: UI Layer
list.description: Streamlit web interface serving the teacher and student pages, together with the typed APIClient that fronts every backend endpoint.

list.name: API Layer
list.description: FastAPI routers and dependency guards exposing auth, courses, documents, curriculum, lessons, quizzes, study plans, classes, and ops endpoints, plus the shared Pydantic request/response contracts in schemas.

list.name: Agent Orchestration Layer
list.description: The multi-agent adaptive-learning pipeline: seven specialized agents (curriculum, planner, lesson, quiz, grading, performance, recommendation) with their base class and message bus, orchestrated through the LangGraph-style graph runtime, tool registry, and background ThreadPoolExecutor task runner.

list.name: Service Layer
list.description: Domain business logic for AI answer grading, deterministic study-plan scheduling, class analytics aggregation, and student topic-mastery computation.

list.name: Knowledge Retrieval (RAG) Layer
list.description: RAG stack that parses uploaded textbooks, chunks content, embeds it via query-aware Nemotron vectors, searches pgvector, and maintains the curriculum and student memory stores.

list.name: LLM Integration Layer
list.description: Provider-agnostic chat and embedding abstraction registering OpenRouter free-model access (with attribution headers, timeouts, and float encoding) alongside a deterministic offline mock provider.

list.name: Data Layer
list.description: SQLAlchemy ORM models for users, courses, curriculum, learning records, conversation memory, and observability, plus the fail-fast PostgreSQL/pgvector engine, pgvector column type, and session management.

list.name: Application Core
list.description: FastAPI application factory wiring routers and startup hooks, pydantic-settings configuration loaded from .env, JWT and password-hashing security primitives, and structured logging.

list.name: Project Configuration & Documentation
list.description: Root-level project metadata: uv/packaging definition (pyproject.toml), Python version pin, environment-variable template, opencode assistant configuration, analysis ignore file, and the README.

file:src/adapted/api/deps.py.name: deps.py
file:src/adapted/api/deps.py.summary: FastAPI dependency layer providing JWT bearer authentication, role-based access guards, and ownership/enrollment assertion helpers shared by every router.

file:src/adapted/api/routers/agent.py.name: agent.py
file:src/adapted/api/routers/agent.py.summary: POST /agent/run endpoint that validates agent intents and dispatches pipeline execution to the background task runner, returning a started-task result immediately.

file:src/adapted/api/routers/agent_ops.p.name: agent_ops.py
file:src/adapted/api/routers/agent_ops.p.summary: Observability endpoints listing agent tasks, inter-agent messages and runs, fronted by a stale-task reaper that fails tasks stuck in 'started' beyond the time budget.

file:src/adapted/api/routers/auth.py.name: auth.py
file:src/adapted/api/routers/auth.py.summary: Registration and login endpoints that hash passwords, create User rows plus Teacher/Student profiles, and issue JWT-backed TokenResponses.

file:src/adapted/api/routers/courses.py.name: courses.py
file:src/adapted/api/routers/courses.py.summary: Course router covering creation, role-scoped listing, enrollment, document upload/listing/status, and cascading deletes (document, contents, whole course) with audit logging and on-disk file cleanup.

file:src/adapted/api/routers/curriculum..name: curriculum.py
file:src/adapted/api/routers/curriculum..summary: Read-only curriculum endpoints serving generated chapters and topics (with objectives and prerequisites) to authorized teachers and enrolled students.

file:src/adapted/api/routers/lessons.py.name: lessons.py
file:src/adapted/api/routers/lessons.py.summary: Lesson endpoints that perform fast authorization checks, dispatch asynchronous lesson generation through the background task runner, and serve generated lessons to authorized viewers.

file:src/adapted/api/routers/logs.py.name: logs.py
file:src/adapted/api/routers/logs.py.summary: Teacher-only audit-log listing endpoint returning the most recent audit entries for the operations view.

file:src/adapted/api/routers/quizzes.py.name: quizzes.py
file:src/adapted/api/routers/quizzes.py.summary: Quiz lifecycle router: async quiz generation, answer-safe retrieval, and submission which persists attempt/answer rows before launching the grading chain in the background.

file:src/adapted/api/routers/students.py.name: students.py
file:src/adapted/api/routers/students.py.summary: Student analytics endpoints (profile, performance, mastery, recommendations, preferences) with self-or-owning-teacher authorization and a default-course fallback.

file:src/adapted/api/routers/study_plans.name: study_plans.py
file:src/adapted/api/routers/study_plans.summary: Study-plan read endpoints returning the active plan (highest version) with its daily items, authorized for the owning student or their teacher.

file:src/adapted/api/routers/users.py.name: users.py
file:src/adapted/api/routers/users.py.summary: Teacher-only user directory search over name/email that joins Student rows to expose grade level and daily study minutes for enrollment pickers.

file:src/adapted/database/session.py.name: session.py
file:src/adapted/database/session.py.summary: Database bootstrap: resolves and connect-probes the PostgreSQL URL (fail-fast, Postgres-only), exposes SessionLocal/get_db/session_scope helpers plus ID generators and init/reset routines including pgvector extension setup.

file:src/adapted/schemas/api.py.name: api.py
file:src/adapted/schemas/api.py.summary: Complete Pydantic v2 API contract layer: request/response models for auth, courses, documents, curriculum, study plans, lessons, quizzes, grading results, performance/mastery, recommendations, and agent observability payloads.

file:src/adapted/security/jwt.py.name: jwt.py
file:src/adapted/security/jwt.py.summary: Minimal JWT helper pair for issuing expiring HS-signed access tokens and decoding them during request authentication.

file:src/adapted/security/passwords.py.name: passwords.py
file:src/adapted/security/passwords.py.summary: bcrypt password hashing and constant-time verification wrappers used by registration and login.

file:src/adapted/tasks/runner.py.name: runner.py
file:src/adapted/tasks/runner.py.summary: Background task runner: persists AgentTask rows, submits pipeline execution to a ThreadPoolExecutor whose workers build their own sessions/runtime, and guarantees failure marking on crashes.

file:src/adapted/agents/lesson_agent.py.name: lesson_agent.py
file:src/adapted/agents/lesson_agent.py.summary: Generates levelled lesson content for a curriculum topic by combining RAG-retrieved textbook chunks, learning objectives and the student profile into a schema-validated LLM request, then persists the resulting Lesson row.

file:src/adapted/config.py.name: config.py
file:src/adapted/config.py.summary: Central pydantic-settings configuration loaded from the repo-root .env: app metadata, PostgreSQL URL, OpenRouter LLM/embedding settings, JWT secrets, RAG limits and retry knobs.

file:src/adapted/llm/base.py.name: base.py
file:src/adapted/llm/base.py.summary: Defines the provider-agnostic LLM contract: a request envelope pairing a prompt with its JSON schema, and the abstract LLMProvider interface every chat/embedding backend implements.

file:src/adapted/llm/mock.py.name: mock.py
file:src/adapted/llm/mock.py.summary: Deterministic offline LLM provider: seeded generators fabricate curricula, lessons, quizzes, grades and recommendations without network access, plus hash-based pseudo-embeddings for fully reproducible runs.

file:src/adapted/llm/openai_compatible.p.name: openai_compatible.py
file:src/adapted/llm/openai_compatible.p.summary: Production provider speaking the OpenAI wire protocol against OpenRouter: JSON-schema-constrained chat generation plus dimension-validated embeddings, bounded by the configured request timeout.

file:src/adapted/llm/registry.py.name: registry.py
file:src/adapted/llm/registry.py.summary: Maps the configured provider names to concrete LLM/embedding implementations behind lru-cached accessors, warning and degrading to MockProvider when OpenRouter credentials are absent.

file:src/adapted/main.py.name: main.py
file:src/adapted/main.py.summary: FastAPI application factory: initialises the PostgreSQL schema on startup, wires CORS, registers every API router (auth, courses, curriculum, lessons, quizzes, study plans, students, teacher, users, agent ops, logs) and exposes /health.

file:src/adapted/memory/curriculum_memor.name: curriculum_memory.py
file:src/adapted/memory/curriculum_memor.summary: Indexes parsed documents into pgvector-backed ContentChunks (chunking, passage embeddings, vector upserts) and links chunks to generated curriculum topics for later retrieval.

file:src/adapted/rag/chunker.py.name: chunker.py
file:src/adapted/rag/chunker.py.summary: Splits parsed document pages into overlapping, heading-aware text chunks carrying page ranges so retrieved passages can be cited.

file:src/adapted/rag/embeddings.py.name: embeddings.py
file:src/adapted/rag/embeddings.py.summary: Thin caching facade over the configured embedding provider: embeds single texts or batches in passage/query modes for indexing and retrieval.

file:src/adapted/rag/parser.py.name: parser.py
file:src/adapted/rag/parser.py.summary: Extracts clean per-page text from uploaded PDF, TXT/MD and DOCX course materials into a ParsedDocument structure, raising UnsupportedDocumentError for anything else.

file:src/adapted/rag/retriever.py.name: retriever.py
file:src/adapted/rag/retriever.py.summary: Query-side retrieval: embeds the question, runs filtered cosine search over the vector store and formats top chunks (with optional citations) into LLM context blocks.

file:src/adapted/rag/vector_store.py.name: vector_store.py
file:src/adapted/rag/vector_store.py.summary: pgvector persistence layer for course-scoped embeddings: collection DDL, idempotent ContentChunk upserts, deletion by document and cosine top-k search with dynamic metadata filters via raw SQL.

file:src/adapted/tools/registry.py.name: registry.py
file:src/adapted/tools/registry.py.summary: Tool belt exposed to agents: RAG lookup, SearXNG web search, study-plan validation, mastery updates and duplicate-question checks packaged as named Tool descriptors.

file:src/adapted/agents/base.py.name: base.py
file:src/adapted/agents/base.py.summary: Defines the BaseAgent abstract class every pipeline agent extends: process() hook, Pydantic validate_output, an output_is_empty hook that drives retry-on-empty, and a handle() wrapper adding timing, MessageBus status marks, and error capture into AgentResult.

file:src/adapted/agents/curriculum_agent.name: curriculum_agent.py
file:src/adapted/agents/curriculum_agent.summary: CurriculumAnalyzerAgent turns an uploaded course document into a structured curriculum: parses and RAG-indexes the file, prompts the LLM with the CurriculumOutput JSON schema, persists chapters/topics/objectives/prerequisites idempotently by title, and assigns indexed chunks to matching topics.

file:src/adapted/agents/grading_agent.py.name: grading_agent.py
file:src/adapted/agents/grading_agent.py.summary: GradingAgent grades a submitted quiz attempt: deterministic objective grading via the grading service, LLM-based short-answer grading with confidence scores, flags low-confidence subjective answers needs_teacher_review, computes the attempt score, and upserts a Grade row.

file:src/adapted/agents/message.py.name: message.py
file:src/adapted/agents/message.py.summary: Inter-agent messaging primitives: the AgentMessage value object and a MessageBus that persists send/mark events to the agent_messages table with duration tracking, giving observability over the multi-agent pipeline.

file:src/adapted/agents/performance_agen.name: performance_agent.py
file:src/adapted/agents/performance_agen.summary: PerformanceAnalysisAgent consumes a graded attempt: updates per-topic StudentMastery records, records study history, detects recurring misconceptions across recent attempts, and emits weak/strong topic lists for downstream adaptation.

file:src/adapted/agents/planner_agent.py.name: planner_agent.py
file:src/adapted/agents/planner_agent.py.summary: StudyPlannerAgent builds or adapts study plans deterministically: loads topics with mastery weights, delegates packing/ordering to the scheduler service (build_plan/adapt_plan), validates prerequisite ordering, packs items into days, and persists a new versioned StudyPlan.

file:src/adapted/agents/quiz_agent.py.name: quiz_agent.py
file:src/adapted/agents/quiz_agent.py.summary: QuizAgent generates assessment questions via a schema-constrained LLM prompt seeded with course context, dedupes against existing question hashes, persists Question rows, and tops up from the existing bank when generation falls short.

file:src/adapted/agents/recommendation_a.name: recommendation_agent.py
file:src/adapted/agents/recommendation_a.summary: RecommendationAgent picks the next best action (e.g. review_topic) from weak topics via _decide, then renders a learner-facing narrative using an LLM prompt with a deterministic mock fallback before persisting a Recommendation row.

file:src/adapted/agents/supervisor.py.name: supervisor.py
file:src/adapted/agents/supervisor.py.summary: Supervisor coordinates pipeline execution: classifies intents into agent action chains, starts/persists AgentTask rows, emits the initial message, routes each action to its receiver agent, and finalizes tasks.

file:src/adapted/graph/runtime.py.name: runtime.py
file:src/adapted/graph/runtime.py.summary: LangGraph-style AgentRuntime: registers all agents, threads a GraphState payload through supervisor-defined chains, executes each node with savepoint-backed retries (_run_with_retry with backoff and empty-output detection), and manages overall task success/failure.

file:src/adapted/logging/logger.py.name: logger.py
file:src/adapted/logging/logger.py.summary: Logging bootstrap: configures root logging once from Settings, exposes get_logger(name), and bind_task to attach task/correlation ids as contextual log fields.

file:src/adapted/services/grading.py.name: grading.py
file:src/adapted/services/grading.py.summary: Pure deterministic grading helpers: stable question_hash/is_duplicate dedup keys, rule-based grade_objective for MCQ/true-false/numerical answers (numeric tolerance via _numeric_equal), compute_attempt_score totals, and rubric_default prompts.

file:src/adapted/services/scheduler.py.name: scheduler.py
file:src/adapted/services/scheduler.py.summary: Deterministic study-plan engine: orders topics topologically over prerequisites, builds day-packed plans weighted toward low mastery and nearing exams, adapts existing plans around weak topics, and validates prerequisite ordering, coverage, and daily minute budgets.

file:src/adapted/database/base.py.name: base.py
file:src/adapted/database/base.py.summary: SQLAlchemy foundation layer providing the shared declarative Base, a pgvector-aware VectorColumn TypeDecorator, and the engine/session factory used by the entire persistence layer.

file:src/adapted/models/__init__.py.name: __init__.py
file:src/adapted/models/__init__.py.summary: Barrel module importing and re-exporting every ORM model so callers use a single adapted.models namespace for Course, Topic, QuizAttempt, and friends.

file:src/adapted/models/course.py.name: course.py
file:src/adapted/models/course.py.summary: Defines the core teaching-domain tables: teacher-owned Courses, student Enrollments joining students to courses, and uploaded Documents tracked through their parsing status for the RAG pipeline.

file:src/adapted/models/curriculum.py.name: curriculum.py
file:src/adapted/models/curriculum.py.summary: Curriculum hierarchy produced by the analysis agent: Chapters group ordered Topics, Topics carry prerequisites and learning objectives, and ContentChunk rows store embedded textbook passages assigned to topics for retrieval.

file:src/adapted/models/learning.py.name: learning.py
file:src/adapted/models/learning.py.summary: Learning-flow tables spanning versioned StudyPlans with daily items, generated Lessons and Questions, Quizzes with question assignments, student attempts carrying per-answer AI-grading and teacher-review flags, and finalized Grades.

file:src/adapted/models/memory.py.name: memory.py
file:src/adapted/models/memory.py.summary: Student-memory tables persisting per-topic mastery with trend history, an append-only study activity log, detected misconceptions, aggregated conversation memory, key-value learning preferences, and agent-generated recommendations.

file:src/adapted/models/observability.py.name: observability.py
file:src/adapted/models/observability.py.summary: Observability tables behind the Operations UI: AgentTask rows track background pipeline runs, AgentMessage logs inter-agent traffic, and AuditLog records audited user actions.

file:src/adapted/models/user.py.name: user.py
file:src/adapted/models/user.py.summary: Identity model: User accounts with hashed credentials and a role discriminator, extended by Teacher profiles (department) and Student profiles (grade level, daily study budget, timezone).

file:src/adapted/api/routers/teacher.py.name: teacher.py
file:src/adapted/api/routers/teacher.py.summary: Teacher-facing API router providing class rosters, course-wide analytics, per-student grade histories, an AI-grade review queue scoped to the teacher's own courses, and manual grade overrides.

file:src/adapted/memory/student_memory.p.name: student_memory.py
file:src/adapted/memory/student_memory.p.summary: Builds and maintains each student's learning state: aggregates mastery records, misconceptions, preferences, quiz attempts, conversation memory, and study history into a StudentProfile snapshot, and persists mastery updates, study events, conversations, and preference changes.

file:src/adapted/services/analytics.py.name: analytics.py
file:src/adapted/services/analytics.py.summary: Pure analytics helpers that split mastery records into weak/strong topic sets, detect recurring misconceptions from graded answers (per MCQ distractor and per topic), and roll per-student mastery maps into a class-wide topic summary.

file:src/adapted/services/mastery.py.name: mastery.py
file:src/adapted/services/mastery.py.summary: Mastery math core: exponential-moving-average mastery updates, trend computation over score history, status-label threshold bands, and MasteryRecord construction.
